OCR problem: the body length without wings of the alate is given in the original as '7.S-9.S mm', whose digits are unreliable, so it has not been entered.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule, pronotum and dorsal abdomen brown; antennae, legs and sternites pale yellowish brown; wing scales and veins brownish, wing membrane transparent. Head and body with long and short hairs. Body length with wings 13.70—15.0 mm. Head capsule subsquare, maximum width about equal to the length to the base of the mandibles (width including compound eyes 1.40—1.55, length 1.20—1.50 mm); head arched in profile; Y-shaped suture indistinct. Compound eyes large, almost circular, diameter 0.45—0.55 mm, close to the antennae, minimum distance between compound eye and antenna 0.025—0.038 mm. Ocelli elongate-oval (long diameter 0.20—0.22 mm), white, translucent, close to but not touching the compound eyes (distance between compound eye and ocellus 0.013—0.025 mm). Antennae 16—19-segmented, segment 2 twice as long as segment 3 (when 19-segmented) or almost as long as segment 3 (when 17-segmented), segment 3 longer than or almost equal to segment 4, lengthening from segment 5 onwards. Postclypeus rectangular, darker than the rest of the head, anterior margin with 2 pairs of hairs; anteclypeus hairless, trapezoidal, narrow, longer than the postclypeus. Labrum straw-coloured, subsquare (length 0.4, width 0.5 mm), with 3—4 hairs at the apex and 1 pair on the disc. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum subrectangular, with long and short hairs; anterior margin deeply concave, without an incision; posterior margin straight, slightly concave in the middle; sides rounded; about twice as wide as long (length 0.8—0.9, width 1.5—1.9 mm), as wide as or slightly wider than the head (including compound eyes). Legs slender and hairy, tibial spurs 3:3:3, tarsus 4-segmented, arolia brown. Wings transparent, without hairs or tubercles. Fore wing about 14.5 mm long, subcosta short, meeting the costa outside the wing scale, radius merging with the costa–subcosta shortly before mid-length of the wing, radial sector with 7 oblique branches to the anterior margin, media with 6 cross-veins to the radial sector, cubitus with 11—13 branches to the posterior margin. Hind wing 12.0—13.0 mm long, radius meeting the costa–subcosta at 1/2 to 2/3 of the wing length, radial sector with 4—6 branches, media arising 1/4 to 1/3 from the proximal end of the radial sector and connected to it by 6—8 cross-veins, cubitus with 10—13 branches. Abdomen slender, each tergite with 2 rows of sparse hairs; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown to dark brown; antennae brown, paler at the base; mandibles black, reddish brown at the base; body and legs pale yellow to light brown. Head and body with long and short hairs. Body length 9.0—11.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel; width about 2/3 to nearly 3/4 of the length (length 1.8—3.5, width 1.07—2.4 mm, width/length index 0.68—0.74); frons sloping forwards at about 45°, shallowly concave in the middle; Y-shaped suture distinct. Compound eyes suboval, translucent, 0.18—0.30 mm long, situated about one eye length from the antennae; ocelli absent. Antennae 14—16-segmented, antennal carinae weak, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 almost equal to or slightly shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus flat, subrectangular, darker than the frons, anterior margin with 2 pairs of hairs; anteclypeus white, distinct, narrow, band-like. Labrum subsquare, rounded at the front, with hairs at the apex and on the disc (length 0.25—0.35, width 0.50—0.60 mm). Mandibles thick and stout, about 1/2 to 2/3 of the head length (length 1.62—1.80 mm, mandible length/head length index 0.51—0.61), not humped at the base. Left mandible with 5 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 large marginal teeth. Postmentum long, clavate; the wider anterior part bilobed, the anterior lobe larger; a slender handle posteriorly, the waist about 1/3 of the maximum width; median length 1.98—2.50, maximum width 0.75—0.90, waist width 0.25—0.30 mm. Pronotum subrectangular, about as wide as the head, nearly twice as wide as long (length 0.81—1.40, width 1.71—2.30 mm); anterior margin deeply concave, with a median incision; posterior margin convex, slightly concave in the middle; sides rounded. Legs long and slender, tibial spurs 3:3:3, tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen slender, each tergite with 2 rows of hairs; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The original gives a pseudoworker: head capsule straw-coloured; antennae, legs and body pale yellow. Head and body with moderately dense hairs. Body length 7.5—9.0 mm. Head capsule almost circular, width almost equal to the length to the base of the mandibles (length 1.5—1.70, width 1.65—1.80 mm); Y-shaped suture indistinct. Compound eyes small, appearing as white spots. Antennae 15—16-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segments 3, 4 and 5 almost equal. Postclypeus flat, rectangular, darker than the frons; anteclypeus white, trapezoidal. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum subrectangular, as wide as the head (length 0.75—0.90, width 1.55—1.89 mm); anterior margin deeply concave, with a weak median incision; posterior margin convex, with or without a median concavity; sides rounded. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
